title: Cobblemon Team Studio
description: A Poke Builder-style Pokémon editor GUI for Cobblemon, designed for creating and customizing Pokémon in-game.
body:
# Cobblemon Team Studio

**Cobblemon Team Studio** is a Poke Builder-style admin GUI for Cobblemon, allowing server staff to create, customize, and add Pokémon directly in-game.

It is designed for server administration, event preparation, map creation, testing environments, and any situation where Pokémon need to be prepared quickly and consistently.

## Usage

You can open the Team Studio editor by using the **Team Builder** item added by the mod, or by running the `/teamstudio` command.

## Features

* In-game Team Studio GUI
* Browse and search Cobblemon species
* Configure Pokémon stats from the GUI
* Add created Pokémon directly to your party
